newsitem.title: USA: Calif. Treasurer says neutral on Proposition 218.
newsitem.headline: Calif. Treasurer says neutral on Proposition 218.

text.p: California state Treasurer Matt Fong said Thursday he has not taken a position on a controversial state tax measure on the November ballot.
"I'm neutral," Fong told a Bond Buyer California municipal finance conference here.

During the conference other speakers warned of the dire consequences of Proposition 218, which is on the November 5 ballot, which would if approved by voters limit the ability of local governments to raise taxes, fees and assesments.

In a recent statement, Fong urged calm in the municipal bond market after several rating agencies and securities firms warned that the approval of the measure could devastate local governments in the state and their credit ratings.
